name: Visualizer pack
author: Voltage
description: Five more progress-bar animations in the song's colours that move with the music: Particles, Ribbon, Pixel blocks, Neon tube and Equalizer. Pick one in Settings > Appearance > Progress animation.

waveStyles.label: Particles
waveStyles.help: Sparks drift off the playhead and fade along the played part; more on loud parts.

waveStyles.label: Ribbon
waveStyles.help: Three soft, overlapping colour ribbons flowing up to the playhead.

waveStyles.label: Pixel blocks
waveStyles.help: A retro, stepped block meter in the song's colour.

waveStyles.label: Neon tube
waveStyles.help: One glowing line that gets thicker and brighter with the music.

waveStyles.label: Equalizer
waveStyles.help: Mirrored bars over the played part, as tall as the music is loud.
